_description: Persistent learnings from KDD pipeline runs. Updated after each batch.

percentage_of_X_with_condition.correct: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN condition THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
percentage_of_X_with_condition.tip: Both numerator and denominator COUNT must use the same base table or JOIN

average_monthly_X.tip: AVG() computes per-row mean. SUM() computes total across all rows.

count_with_group_filter.correct: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ... GROUP BY ... HAVING COUNT(*) > N
wrong: WHERE COUNT(*) > N (can't use aggregate in WHERE)
count_with_group_filter.tip: Use HAVING for aggregate conditions, WHERE for row conditions

ratio_how_many_times.correct: SUM(CASE WHEN A THEN amount END) / SUM(CASE WHEN B THEN amount END)
ratio_how_many_times.tip: Ratio = A/B. Difference = A-B. Read the question carefully.

lowest_highest_with_name.correct: SELECT name FROM table ORDER BY value ASC|DESC LIMIT 1
wrong: SELECT MIN(value) (returns value, not the associated name)
lowest_highest_with_name.tip: MIN/MAX returns the value. To get the associated row, use ORDER BY + LIMIT 1.

join_for_human_readable_names.correct: JOIN the reference table to get names instead of IDs
wrong: Returning raw IDs like 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v' instead of names
join_for_human_readable_names.tip: If the question asks for names/descriptions, JOIN to get them.

filter_with_domain_knowledge.correct: Read knowledge.md to map question terms to exact column values. E.g., 'severe thrombosis' = Thrombosis=2, 'abnormal creatinine' needs the specific threshold from knowledge.md
wrong: Guessing filter values without reading knowledge.md
Using wrong column for a condition (e.g., filtering on Patient table when the value is in Examination table)
filter_with_domain_knowledge.tip: When the question uses domain terms (severe, abnormal, normal), ALWAYS check knowledge.md for the exact mapping to column values and which table contains the column.

multi_table_filter_chain.correct: Join ALL tables needed to satisfy ALL conditions. E.g., 'members from Illinois' needs member → zip_code JOIN to access state column
wrong: Assuming a filter column exists in the main table when it's in a reference table
Missing a JOIN and getting 0 results or wrong results
multi_table_filter_chain.tip: Before writing SQL, list every condition in the question and verify which table has each column. If a condition's column is in a different table, you MUST JOIN.
